newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists upbeat on AEX index.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Dutch chartists upbeat on AEX index.

text.p: Dutch technical analysts remain bullish about the outlook for the AEX index this week as it continues to move into unmapped territory with new all-time highs.
All three of this week's contributors to a Reuters poll saw the index in an uptrend, compared to three of four last week.
The AEX closed at a record 615.47 on Friday, 6.59 points above last Friday's close. On Monday, the AEX gained 7.80 points to a new record of 623.27.
Contributor Trend Pvs view Support Resistance

FIBONNACI PRESS -- The intermediate term trend is still up. The short-term trend is up, but is due to top out this week, probably from higher resistance levels. Followed by a short-term correction in December. We see higher resistance at 625, 632 and 639. Only a drop now below 617 suggests the market topped out already. Support in that case in the area 605, followed by renewed strength. Critical support for the bullish case lies at 594.

ING BARINGS -- The uptrend of the AEX is still intact. Last week's breach above minor horizontal resistance around 611.80 has triggered another buy signal. Volume has been on average indicating that buyers are still dominating the market. Money flow indicators, remaining extremely bullish, do not show any sign of negative divergence. This is a very strong positive because it shows the underlying flow of new funds into the market has not stopped yet. Advance/decline ratios remain strong as well, suggesting there is still good leadership in this market. The A/D ratio's show that the majority of Amsterdam stocks are in rising mode.
The technical outlook remains positive as long as the index stays above a rising support line around 614. Next support at 604. Short term objectives are 621 and 623, then long term resistance at 630.
